children: Governance voting on Osmosis Proposal 1052 closes on 14 Oct 2026. The proposal would increase OSMO stakers' share of non-OSMO taker fees from 22.5% to 47.5%, while leaving the burn share unchanged.

If approved, the allocation change would direct more than twice the current share of these fees to stakers. It changes how collected fees are distributed rather than establishing a fixed staking yield. The amount received by stakers would still depend on the actual volume of non-OSMO taker fees collected, so the larger percentage alone does not determine realized returns. The vote outcome determines whether the proposed allocation takes effect.
Two more steps in simplifying Osmosis are voting onchain.
Prop 1051: active validators go from 70 to 30.
Prop 1052: stakers' share of non-OSMO taker fees goes from 22.5% to 47.5%. The burn share is unchanged.

title: Osmosis: Proposal 1052 voting closes on taker fee share increase - 14 Oct 2026
